Assistant A fails to provide any actual code or implementation, offering only an introductory sentence without the promised program. Assistant B, while its code contains logical flaws (it concatenates per-file top-5 lists rather than aggregating counts across all files to find the global top-5, and it doesn't handle case/punctuation normalization), at least delivers a complete, runnable Python program with explanation that attempts to solve the problem. Since providing a functional attempt is strictly better than providing no code at all, Assistant B answers the user's question more effectively.

[[B]]
